text:
elena: Quick sync — AcmeCloud marketplace private-offer + HW bundle. We need a clean plan for commit tiers, SKU-to-SKU mapping, and a tight announce window. Can we align on discount ladder and renewal incentives?
ben: +1. Sales needs predictable SKUs and a lead-gen trigger for the private offer. Suggest 3 tiers: entry, growth, enterprise.
kai: We should map pricing to expected monthly consumption not just SKU. Commit tiers should have clear uplift thresholds (e.g., 25%, 50% discount breakpoints).
maria: From product POV, we want minimal surface area for customers. Prefer a single marketplace SKU that expands with usage rather than 3 separate SKUs. But partner may insist on hardware SKUs.
elena: Good note — partner wants HW SKU tied to appliance serials. Can we do a composite SKU in the marketplace that maps to HW entitlement?
devon: Legal: private offers must include an explicit renewal opt-in clause and auto-notice 60 days before term end. Also need data residency and entitlements spelled out for dedicated capacity.
sara: Solution eng: operationally we can attach a usage anchor that unlocks the private offer discounts after a telemetry-based eligibility check. Ops effort ~2 sprint days.
ben: For the discount ladder, draft:```
- Tier A (entry): commit $50k/yr -> 10% discount + 30-day renewal credit
- Tier B (growth): commit $250k/yr -> 18% discount + 60-day renewal credit
- Tier C (enterprise): commit $1M/yr -> 28% discount + dedicated onboarding credit
```
kai: Numbers look reasonable. Recommend reserved capacity uplift for Tier C (guaranteed Dedicated nodes) and a price floor to protect margin. Also include a clause for currency FX adjustments.
maria: UX question — how do we surface the renewal incentives in-console? We can add a banner and renewal CTA that references the private offer terms and countdown. I'll need the exact copy.
elena: Let's aim for an internal comms/announce window: partner co-announce on Wed 2 weeks from now, marketplace private-offer visible 48hrs earlier to partner sales. That gives their field time to prep. Thoughts?
ben: Works if legal signoff by EOD next Tue. Sales enablement assets need to land 3 business days before partner visibility. I'll coordinate.
devon: I'll push the contract template updates today and flag the renewal clause. Expect review comments by tomorrow noon.
sara: FYI — small ops note: the SKU mapping will require a short webhook to verify serial entitlement on first activation. I'll drop a template snippet in the partnership repo.
kai: One more ask: include a 12-month minimum consumption remediation clause (if customer under-consumes <60% commit, we step down discounts on renewal). Keeps economics sane.
maria: Agreed. We'll also add a quality gating eval tied to model latency/throughput so we don't expose heavy models under entry tier.
elena: Action items: elena -> confirm partner announce date; ben -> create sales enablement checklist; kai -> finalize margin floor + remediation clause; devon -> contract update; maria -> console copy + gating; sara -> entitlement webhook template. Check back here with updates by EOD Monday :thumbsup:
ben: On it. I'll upload the enablement deck once draft is ready.
kai: I'll circulate the pricing sheet for sign-off.
devon: Contract PR incoming.
maria: I'll prototype the console banner and share screenshots.
sara: Will add webhook stub to repo and tag infra for review.
elena: Thanks team — if we can hit the dates we should be able to co-announce cleanly. cc @ben @maria @kai :partyparrot:
